item.title: Spain sees first general strike in over a decade ahead of national elections
item.description: Labor unions in Spain have launched the country's first general strike in 14 years. Protests are occurring in major cities as the nation prepares for parliamentary elections in less than three weeks.

item.title: বলিউডের ছয় তারকা ও তাঁদের দেখতে একরকমের হলিউড শিল্পীরা
item.description: কিছু তারকার মুখের আদলের সাথে হলিউডের অভিনয়শিল্পীদের অসাধারণ মিল রয়েছে। এই প্রতিবেদনে তেমন ছয়জন সেলিব্রিটির চেহারার সাদৃশ্য তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

item.title: Poundland Seeks Urgent Buyer to Avoid Potential Collapse
item.description: The discount retailer is approaching potential administration but anticipates receiving additional time to secure a rescue agreement. Observers report ongoing efforts to find an acquirer.

item.title: Home Assistant Introduces New Versatile Hardware Device
item.description: Nabu Casa has released the Home Assistant Connect Aux-2, a versatile multi-function hardware box created for smart home systems. The device serves various technical purposes within home automation setups.

item.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents From Booking Tickets
item.description: United Airlines has announced it will not permit personal artificial intelligence agents to purchase flight tickets. The carrier pointed to strict regulatory rules and user privacy protection as the main reasons.

item.title: Trump Envoys Scheduled to Visit Moscow and Ireland
item.description: Representatives appointed by Donald Trump plan to hold discussions with Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Afterward, the delegates will travel to Ireland for meetings with Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

item.title: JetBlue to showcase new first-class seating as part of profitability strategy
item.description: The airline's leadership is focusing on premium offerings to improve financial performance and address creditor concerns. A media preview of the company's latest first-class cabin design is scheduled for Wednesday.

item.title: Trump Official Reportedly Delayed Nvidia Chip Crackdown
item.description: Axios reports that Trump official Howard Lutnick delayed measures against firms diverting Nvidia chips to China. President Trump later authorized a crackdown following consultations with Elon Musk.

item.title: Premier League Transfer Rumors: Arsenal Target Scott
item.description: Arsenal has reportedly reached out to Bournemouth regarding midfielder Alex Scott. Meanwhile, Manchester United and Aston Villa are monitoring other potential player acquisitions.

item.title: UK Labour MPs Oppose Rosebank Oil Field Approvals
item.description: Several Labour lawmakers have publicly criticized the Rosebank oil drilling project as expectations grow that the government will approve it. Critics argue that opening the field is the wrong approach.

item.title: Mass Protests and Strike Over Housing in Spain
item.description: Massive demonstrations and a general strike have erupted across Spain due to an ongoing housing emergency. The crisis has also forced early elections scheduled for November 29.

item.title: কুষ্টিয়ায় সংরক্ষিত নারী এমপি নুসরাত তাবাসসুমের বাড়িতে হামলা
item.description: এনসিপি নেতাদের ভাষ্য অনুযায়ী, সংরক্ষিত নারী আসনের সংসদ সদস্য নুসরাত তাবাসসুমের কুষ্টিয়ার বাসভবনে পেট্রল বোমা নিক্ষেপ করা হয়েছে। এই ঘটনার পর রাজনৈতিক অঙ্গনে চাঞ্চল্যের সৃষ্টি হয়েছে।

item.title: Texas appeals court rules in Dhingra estate deed dispute
item.description: The Texas First Court of Appeals permitted Doctor R.K. Dhingra's estate to drop its claims against a subsequent buyer. This ruling overturned a previous decision by the trial court in a forged-deed case involving Malachite Venture Corporation.

item.title: New right whale calf spotted in Quebec, season total hits 24
item.description: Researchers verified a new North Atlantic right whale calf born to a 38-year-old mother named Silt near Quebec. This addition elevates the current season's count to 24, marking the highest figure recorded since 2009.

item.title: Iran official says Hormuz Strait will not return to prior status
item.description: The Iranian parliament speaker and chief negotiator stated that the Strait of Hormuz will never revert to its pre-war condition. He added that Tehran currently awaits an official American reply regarding seven specific conditions.

item.title: Crowds gather in Warsaw for Polish Independence Day march
item.description: Crowds of participants filled the thoroughfares of Warsaw to observe the annual national Independence Day procession in Poland. The event drew large numbers of citizens into the capital streets.

item.title: Email bomb threats sent to schools in UK, Ireland and Italy
item.description: Numerous educational institutions throughout the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Italy were targeted with fraudulent bomb threat messages sent via email. Authorities are currently monitoring the situation across the affected regions.

item.title: Gene Simmons lowers Beverly Hills property price by nearly $2m
item.description: Musician Gene Simmons has reduced the listing price of his Beverly Hills residential estate by approximately two million dollars. The property is now on the market for a lower sum than previously advertised.

item.title: Gold bear figurine and bones discovered in Kazakhstan mound
item.description: Kazakhstan researchers uncovered a 2,200-year-old golden bear figurine alongside numerous skeletal remains inside a large Iron Age burial mound. The ancient structure is believed to have potentially contained seven individuals.

item.title: Sydney Police Open Murder Probe After Torso Found on Sofa
item.description: Australian authorities initiated a murder investigation on Wednesday following the discovery of an adult male's torso inside a couch located in a Sydney wooded area.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine Agree to Prisoner Exchange at Abu Dhabi Talks
item.description: Moscow and Kyiv finalized a major prisoner swap as negotiations in Abu Dhabi concluded on Wednesday, though specific numbers were withheld. Meanwhile, US envoys are scheduled to hold individual discussions with the Russian leader.

item.title: Supreme Court Rules Foreign Divorces Unrecognized in India
item.description: India's top court ruled that overseas dissolutions of marriage grounded on reasons unaccepted by domestic law are void. Consequently, individuals remarrying following such rulings could face bigamy charges.

item.title: Saudi Coalition Intercepts Houthi Missiles and Drones
item.description: The military coalition in Yemen reported destroying three cruise missiles targeting Riyadh, alongside drones and projectiles aimed at Mecca and other regions. The Houthi movement denied targeting Mecca.

item.title: OPEC Reports Global Oil Output Nearing Pre-Conflict Levels
item.description: OPEC stated that crude production is approaching levels seen before the Iran conflict, with Saudi Arabia noting multi-month highs in output despite ongoing transport bottlenecks.

item.title: Palestinian Goalkeeper Killed in Israeli Strike in Gaza
item.description: Football player Mahmoud Abdel-Malek lost his life in an Israeli military strike in Gaza, occurring shortly after the conclusion of the Thousand Martyrs Cup tournament.

item.title: DRC Constitutional Law Sparks Political Controversy
item.description: A newly enacted legislation broadening referendum criteria has sparked political friction within the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Additionally, Kenya announced the conclusion of its recent Ebola epidemic.

item.title: White House Dismisses Democratic Congressional Probe Plans
item.description: The White House criticized upcoming Democratic congressional investigations as an abuse of power. Representative Robert Garcia countered, calling the administration's correspondence an unconstitutional assault on the legislature.

item.title: Massive Labor Protest Shuts Down Businesses Across Spain
item.description: Workers throughout Spain halted public transportation and commercial activity on Wednesday during the nation's initial nationwide strike since 2010. Demonstrators gathered in Barcelona for an orderly rally addressing expensive housing costs and escalating inflation.

item.title: Residents Return to Gaza City District Following Fatal Attack
item.description: Palestinian residents went back to the Sabra area of Gaza City after a military bombardment by Israeli forces resulted in three deaths. The families returned to assess their neighborhood in the aftermath of the strike.

item.title: Deceased Female Discovered in Locked Baranagar Apartment
item.description: Law enforcement authorities discovered a woman's body inside a secured residence in Baranagar, with initial investigations indicating potential sexual violence. The premises belong to the victim's sister and brother-in-law, who relocated to Hooghly for job opportunities after occupying the home for four years.

item.title: ঢাকায় স্বেচ্ছাসেবক দলের নেতা লিটন মাহমুদ গ্রেপ্তারের পেছনে চাঁদাবাজির অভিযোগ
item.description: ঢাকা মহানগর পুলিশ শহরের বিভিন্ন স্থানে চাঁদাবাজিতে জড়িত ব্যক্তিদের একাধিক নামের তালিকা প্রস্তুত করেছে। মোহাম্মদপুর অঞ্চলে চাঁদাবাজির অভিযুক্ত হিসেবে লিটন মাহমুদের নাম সেসব তালিকায় অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে।

item.title: Ukrainian Leader Anticipates Possible Peace Progress Prior to 2027
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced on Wednesday that a potential chance to achieve progress in peace negotiations with Russia may open before 2027. He offered these comments upon landing in Ireland, where discussions with diplomats from the United States are planned.

item.title: Trump Defends Conflict With Iran, Insisting US Did Not Initiate Hostilities
item.description: Donald Trump offered a defense of war with Iran during recent remarks. He maintained that the United States was not responsible for starting the hostilities.

item.title: Racing Champion Urges Reopening of Rafah Border Crossing
item.description: Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton requested that Israeli authorities grant access through the Rafah crossing along the Gaza boundary. His appeal followed a trip to the frontier between Egypt and Gaza, where severe rainfall worsened living conditions for local residents.

item.title: Congress Starts Campaign in Punjab as Rival Party Criticizes Launch
item.description: State Congress chief Pargat Singh alongside Assembly Opposition Leader Partap Singh Bajwa initiated the political party's electoral effort at their headquarters in Chandigarh. The opposition Bharatiya Janata Party publicly mocked the official campaign launch.

item.title: New York's First Palestinian American Lawmaker Discusses Priorities
item.description: State senator-elect Aber Kawas stated that living costs in New York and the conflict in Gaza motivated her campaign. She shared her perspective in an interview with Al Jazeera.

item.title: পাহাড়ে সশস্ত্র হামলায় পাঁচ বছরে নিহত ৩১৬
item.description: স্বরাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী সালাহউদ্দিন আহমদ সংসদে জানান, গত পাঁচ বছরে পাহাড়ি অঞ্চলে সশস্ত্র দলের হামলায় আটটি নিরাপত্তা বাহিনীর সদস্যসহ মোট ৩১৬ জন মারা গেছেন এবং ৪৯০ জন আহত হয়েছেন।

item.title: Trump Claims US Did Not Initiate Iran Conflict, Seeks Total Victory
item.description: At the Arlington National Cemetery Veterans Day event, Trump stated the US retaliated against Iran. He asserted that American military strikes heavily crippled Iranian capabilities.

item.title: Missing PM2.5 Data May Have Masked Delhi Diwali Pollution
item.description: Research shows Delhi's Diwali pollution metrics were skewed due to missing PM2.5 sensor readings. CREA analysis indicates actual smog levels could have been 49 percent higher.

item.title: Publishing Industry Had Genuine Worries About David Walliams
item.description: An author noted that the publishing sector held real anxieties regarding David Walliams. The comedian has refuted historical accusations of misconduct and abuse of power.

item.title: ভ্রাম্যমাণ খাবারের ব্যবসার নিবন্ধনের সুযোগ নেই: বিএফএসএ
item.description: বাংলাদেশ নিরাপদ খাদ্য কর্তৃপক্ষের প্রধান মো. শফিকুল ইসলাম জানিয়েছেন, ভ্যান বা মাথায় করে যারা খাবার বিক্রি করেন, তাদের নিবন্ধিত করার কোনো বর্তমান ব্যবস্থা নেই।

item.description: Pinarayi Vijayan has accused the Keralam administration of concentrating governance authority within the Chief Minister's office.

item.title: Kerala HC Directs Mental Health Facilities to Stock Medicines
item.description: The Kerala High Court mandated that the state ensure sufficient medical supplies and transport vehicles at mental health facilities by November 24.

item.title: Investigation Clears African Literary Prize Winner of Using AI
item.description: An inquiry into an African literary award found zero proof that the winning text was created by artificial intelligence. Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza strongly rejected the claim, which originated in an American publication.

item.title: Hurdles Threaten Proposed Data Center Developments
item.description: The rapid expansion of data centers faces major practical hurdles, including community pushback, regulatory holdups, and power shortages. Additionally, numerous planned facilities face fundamental viability issues before construction even begins.

item.title: Court Dismisses Ohio Man's Appeal Over Unequal Property Payout
item.description: An Ohio appellate court threw out a man's challenge regarding his smaller portion of real estate sale proceeds. Randall Petersen had contested the lower court's distribution, which gave him $23,161 while his co-owner received $171,635.

item.title: Final Marilyn Monroe Photo Collection Heading to Paris Auction
item.description: Images from photographer Bert Stern's private estate, featuring the famous final photo session with Marilyn Monroe, will be sold at a Paris auction. This event represents the initial public offering from Stern's personal archives.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Trigonometrical Survey Sites Compiled in Five Volumes
item.description: Historic Great Trigonometrical Survey locations situated in Tamil Nadu have been thoroughly documented. The comprehensive findings have been released to the public across a five-volume publication.

item.title: Meta Infrastructure Chief Santosh Janardhan to Step Down
item.description: Santosh Janardhan is leaving his position overseeing infrastructure at Meta. He had been with the technology firm since starting there in 2009.

item.title: Qatar Museum Displays Uzbek Cultural and Historical Artifacts
item.description: Qatar's Museum of Islamic Art is currently hosting an exhibition featuring Uzbekistan's diverse heritage. The display highlights various intercultural objects originating from the Central Asian nation.

item.title: Kerala High Court Receives Review Petition in Accident Case
item.description: The daughter of a traffic collision victim from Cheranalloor has submitted a review petition to the Kerala High Court. The legal filing seeks a re-examination of the previous judicial proceedings concerning the incident.
